meaning: From no premises: a witness that some being has and lacks a predicate in a respect is an instance P x r ∧ ¬ P x r, refuted by Lean-logic non-contradiction (LOGIC-NON-CONTRADICTION, reused). Refutes the dialetheic rival STMT-SOME-CASE-PREDICATE-CONTRADICTION-TRUE relative to the F1 floor marking (D-L, #1007); it does not represent a paraconsistent negation.
